verdict.rationale: Deel Immigration is a SaaS platform, so publishing a machine-readable API spec is a fair question. The evidence documents no downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec: every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404. The llms.txt file that does exist is a different capability, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
